messages:
anya: FYI i'm refactoring the 'getting-started' quickstart into a tiny 'hello-get' example for the signup modal. aim: 1 screen, clear auth, one minimal request, and a deploy button. opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/524

mike.dev: love it. two small requests: standardize on REDWOOD_KEY (we adopted that across SDKs) and include a 2-line python example + curl. keep responses tiny.

anya: switched to REDWOOD_KEY, adding curl + py. trimming prose to single-lines per step.

harper: can you also add a one-line note about token scopes (generation vs embeddings) and a CORS pointer for browser tryouts? one sentence each.

anya: added both. CORS note: "Browser requests require a backend proxy or hosted playground for safe token handling; see Security docs." Token scope note: "Use a generation-scoped token for generator endpoints; embedding tokens are scoped differently."

mike.dev: minor nit: bump Docker examples to node:20 and use compact JSON in the example response so it renders inline.

anya: updated Dockerfile base to node:20 and changed response to: {"id":"r_9","output":"Hello"}. added a tiny troubleshooting FAQ for 401s:
```
# 401? ensure env var set:
export REDWOOD_KEY=sk_test_xxx
```

docbot: markdown lint: found heading level skip at line 12. suggested fix applied.

ci-bot: linkcheck failed: 1 broken link -> /docs/legacy/deploy-guide.html

anya: replaced with /docs/deploy/buttons and pushed.

ci-bot: all checks passed for PR #524 (lint, mdx, linkcheck) :white_check_mark:

harper: looks good to me. please merge so this can land in the next deploy.

mike.dev: approved. merging after CI.

ci-bot: PR #524 merged by anya  deploy to staging queued.
